description: Aura Phase-M = masterplan Phase 7C (Projection Freshness Registry). Lands a per-collection freshness registry + per-doc content-hash drift detection + eager write-time invalidate + retrieval-time annotation so the agent can decide not to trust degraded results. Triggered by the 2026-05-16 brainstorm 'memoria industry-level' (Mem0 v3 ADD-only + Letta typed blocks + LlamaIndex DocstoreStrategy + Qdrant aliases + Weaviate auto-timestamps). 4 atomic stories, each one commit on master. Pattern carried over from Phase-K/L: additive migrations, tests lock the contract, single-seam writers. Reference docs in tree (canonical): docs/phase07c-current-state-audit-2026-05-16.md (file:line inventory of what Aura HAS), docs/phase07c-academic-research-2026-05-16.md (arXiv evidence + ADOPT/AVOID), docs/phase07c-web-research-frameworks-2026-05-16.md (Qdrant/Vespa/Weaviate/LlamaIndex/Letta/OpenAI/Anthropic comparison), docs/phase07c-mem0-elysia-patterns-2026-05-16.md (sintesi finale + decisione scope).

userStories.title: Add projection_state table + freshness.Store Go API (pure types + storage, no consumers wired)
userStories.description: Introduce the canonical per-projection registry. ONE row per index unit (5 total: wiki_documents_fts5, aura_memory_v1 qdrant, compact_memory_documents, aura_memory_v1_compact qdrant, embedding_cache). Optimistic-concurrency update pattern (Letta-style). Pure types + storage + tests; no caller integration in this story. (a) New migration v12 `addProjectionState` in `internal/db/migrations/migrations.go` registered slice (line ~30) AND mirrored in `currentSchemaSQL` so fresh-DB bootstrap is consistent. Schema: `projection_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL ('fts5'|'qdrant'|'sqlite'|'cache'), embedding_model_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', embedding_dim INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, index_build_id TEXT NOT NULL, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, last_full_rebuild_at INTEGER NOT NULL, last_incremental_at INTEGER, pending_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, completed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh' (one of 'fresh'|'rebuilding'|'degraded'|'stale_swap'), health_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (unixepoch())`. (b) New package `internal/storage/freshness/` with `Store` struct + 5 methods: `Get(projectionID) (Row, bool, error)`, `Upsert(row Row) (Row, error)` (uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT), `UpdateWithVersion(projectionID string, mutator func(*Row) error) (Row, error)` (optimistic concurrency: SELECT row + apply mutator + UPDATE WHERE version=old; if 0 rows affected return ErrVersionConflict), `BumpPending(projectionID string, delta int) error`, `List(ctx) ([]Row, error)`. (c) `Row` struct mirrors the schema (camelCase Go fields). `ErrVersionConflict = errors.New('freshness: version conflict')` exported. (d) No consumer wiring: do NOT touch memoryindex/rebuild.go, search/, memory_search.go, app.go in this story. (e) Tests in `internal/storage/freshness/store_test.go`: 4 cases — Upsert+Get roundtrip; UpdateWithVersion happy path increments version; UpdateWithVersion concurrent conflict returns ErrVersionConflict; List returns all rows.

userStories.title: Stamp content_hash + embedding_model_id + index_build_id on compact_memory_documents
userStories.description: Add the per-doc drift detection signal — LlamaIndex `DocstoreStrategy.UPSERTS` pattern as a native column on the source-of-truth table, mirrored into the Qdrant payload (Mem0 v3 pattern). NO new sidecar table. (a) New migration v13 `addCompactMemoryFreshnessColumns` adds 3 columns to `compact_memory_documents`: `content_hash TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`, `embedding_model_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`, `index_build_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`. (b) Mirror in `currentSchemaSQL`. (c) Extend `memoryindex.Document` struct in `internal/storage/memoryindex/store.go` with corresponding Go fields: `ContentHash string`, `EmbeddingModelID string`, `IndexBuildID string`. (d) `ReplaceKind` and `Append` writers in `internal/storage/memoryindex/rebuild.go` accept these fields and persist them. (e) `memoryindex.Store.Search` returns these fields on hits (SELECT updated to include new columns). (f) Update the compact Qdrant payload (`compactPayload` in `internal/storage/search/compact_qdrant.go:247-264` per audit doc) to include `content_hash`, `embedding_model_id`, `index_build_id` keys when populated (omit if empty string — back-compat). (g) NO writer in this story actually FILLS the fields with real values — that comes in US-M03. The schema accepts empty defaults safely. (h) Helper function `internal/storage/memoryindex/hash.go::ContentHash(role, body, embeddingModelID string) string` returns sha256 hex of `role + '\n' + body + '\n' + embeddingModelID` (matches Mem0 pattern: text + model). (i) Tests: existing tests still pass with empty defaults; new `TestDocumentRoundTripWithFreshnessColumns` writes a Document with all 3 new fields populated, reads back, asserts equality. New `hash_test.go` covers `ContentHash` (deterministic, role-sensitive, model-sensitive).

userStories.title: Wire eager invalidation hooks + populate freshness columns at write time
userStories.description: Now make the registry LIVE. (a) On app boot (`cmd/aura/app.go` after migration ready, before reindex worker start): seed the 5 projection_state rows if missing — projection_ids: `wiki_documents_fts5`, `aura_memory_v1`, `compact_memory_documents`, `aura_memory_v1_compact`, `embedding_cache`. Initial row: kind set per target (fts5/qdrant/sqlite/cache), embedding_model_id read from settings (resolve to 'embeddinggemma-300m@256-mrl' if compact Qdrant active, '' for fts5), embedding_dim=256 for Qdrant rows / 0 for fts5+cache, index_build_id = new ULID, last_full_rebuild_at = unixepoch(), status='fresh'. Use freshness.Store.Upsert from US-M01. Idempotent: if row already exists, leave alone. (b) Populate freshness columns in `IndexingTurnAppender.Append` (`internal/storage/memoryindex/rebuild.go:308-324`): compute `content_hash = ContentHash(role, content, embedModel)`, write `embedding_model_id` and `index_build_id` from the current projection_state row of `compact_memory_documents` (via injected `freshness.Store`). Same for `Rebuild` (source/archive/proposal kinds). (c) Eager invalidation hooks: when a writer detects content_hash change OR when a hit Document has missing/stale embedding_model_id, call `freshness.Store.BumpPending(projectionID, 1)`. Implement for these write paths (per audit doc §C): `IndexingTurnAppender.Append` (turn write) AND `memoryindex.Store.ReplaceKind` (rebuild path). (d) New `freshness.Store.MarkRebuildComplete(projectionID, newBuildID, newModelID)` method bumps `completed_count`, resets `pending_count` to 0, updates `index_build_id`, sets `last_full_rebuild_at`. Called from `Rebuild` at completion. (e) Test in `internal/storage/memoryindex/rebuild_test.go`: TestAppendBumpsPendingOnHashMismatch — fixture with existing row hash A, append same id with new content (hash B), assert pending_count incremented by 1. TestRebuildResetsPendingAndUpdatesBuildID — pre-state pending=5, Rebuild called, post-state pending=0 + new build_id. (f) Test for app.go boot seeding in `cmd/aura/app_test.go` if exists OR in a new `app_init_test.go`: 5 projection_state rows exist after boot init. Wiki + Qdrant invalidation NOT wired in this slice (deferred).

userStories.title: Surface freshness annotations on search_memory tool results
userStories.description: Make the registry observable to the agent at retrieval time. The agent can then decide not to trust degraded results. (a) `internal/agent/tools/registry/memory_search.go formatMemoryResults` (line 384+): for each hit, append a `freshness=` token containing the most-relevant fields from the Document populated by US-M02 + the projection_state row. Format: `freshness=indexed_at=<RFC3339>,model=<short>,build=<short>` when fields are present (omit fields with empty defaults). `<short>` truncates to first 12 chars of the ULID/model name. Example: `freshness=indexed_at=2026-05-14T08:21:33Z,model=embeddinggemma,build=01HXY8K2QR`. (b) Plus when the hit's projection row status is NOT 'fresh', emit `degraded_read=true` as a separate token. Use the new helper `freshness.Store.Get(projectionID)` once per search (cache for hit batch). (c) Update `memoryResult` struct in memory_search.go to carry the new fields (IndexedAt, EmbeddingModelID, IndexBuildID, DegradedRead). (d) Wire end-to-end: search_memory tool reads compact_memory_documents → memoryResult gets the new fields from Document (already populated by US-M02). Cross-reference projection_state once per tool call. (e) NO change to schema or tool parameters; only output formatter shape grows. Add a brief description hint in the tool Description() that `freshness=` may appear on hits when populated. (f) Tests in `memory_search_test.go`: TestFreshnessTokenPresent — fixture with populated freshness columns + projection_state status='fresh' returns hit with freshness= and NO degraded_read. TestDegradedReadFlag — fixture with projection_state status='degraded' returns hit with degraded_read=true. TestEmptyFreshnessOmitted — fixture with empty defaults on freshness columns returns hit with NO freshness= token (back-compat). (g) Existing memory_search snapshot/golden tests must stay green with empty defaults.
